verdict.rationale: cubic documents an official first-party MCP server. Coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex and Gemini CLI can connect to it to read review findings, look up codebase docs, request PR reviews and triage scan issues, and the changelog adds subscription and seat-management tools. The probe confirms a dedicated MCP server docs page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect cubic's MCP server to your coding agent to read review findings and codebase context, request PR reviews, and triage PR or codebase scan issues.
cubic's MCP server lets your coding agent read review findings, look up codebase documentation, request PR reviews, triage PR or codebase scan issues
